speaker: conductor_m
text: Kampala! Kampala! Paaka! Two seats, tugende!
note: Paaka = the taxi park; tugende = let's go

speaker: conductor_m
text: Ntinda, Ntinda, Ntinda! Ekifo kimu kisigadde!
note: Ekifo kimu kisigadde = one seat remains

speaker: conductor_m
text: Wandegeya! Makerere! Jangu, jangu, sebo!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Kireka! Kireka! Seat eriyo, nyabo!
note: Seat eriyo = there is a seat; nyabo = madam

speaker: conductor_m
text: Nakawa, Nakawa! We are going, we are going! Don't remain!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Extend a bit, nyabo, extend! Let the sebo sit.

speaker: conductor_m
text: Abali e Ntinda, muyingire! Muyingire!
note: Those going to Ntinda, get in!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Bring the money, bring the money! Two thousand, two thousand!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Stage! Stage! Driver, someone is alighting!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Ggaba, Ggaba! Last seat by the window!

speaker: conductor_m
text: Old Park! Old Park! Gwe sebo, ogenda?
note: Gwe sebo, ogenda? = You sir, are you going?

speaker: conductor_m
text: Kisaasi! Kyanja! Tugende, we are full!

speaker: boda_m
text: Boss, boda? Where are we going?

speaker: boda_m
text: Nyabo, boda! I'll take you cheap cheap.

speaker: boda_m
text: Sit well, hold tight. We are branching here.

speaker: boda_m
text: Banange, this jam! Let me pass from the side.

speaker: boda_m
text: Where should I drop you? Here at the stage?

speaker: boda_m
text: Give me five thou, sebo. It's not far.

speaker: boda_m
text: Pay me on mobile money. I'm sending you the number.

speaker: boda_m
text: Tugende! Hold your bag well.

speaker: boda_m
text: Eh, this rain! Let us first stand under the verandah.

speaker: boda_m
text: Webale nnyo, boss. Call me any time!
note: Webale nnyo = thank you very much

speaker: vendor_m
text: Rolex! Rolex! Hot rolex, sebo, two eggs!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Chapati hot hot! Come and eat!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Nyabo, I add for you cabbage and tomato, free!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Kikomando! Chapati and beans, cheap cheap!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Muchomo! Muchomo! Hot goat meat on the stick!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Gonja! Roasted gonja, sweet sweet!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Come and eat muchomo, it is fresh, I swear!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Bring the bike, boss! Tyre, chain, we fix fast!

speaker: vendor_m
text: Your chain is crying, sebo. Let me oil it.

speaker: vendor_m
text: Puncture? No problem. Five minutes only.

speaker: vendor_f
text: Matooke! Fresh matooke! Come, nyabo, I give you a good price!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Tomatoes, onions, sukuma wiki! Come and see!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Sebo, buy from me today. I'll reduce for you!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Eh, nyabo, you are lost! Come, I've kept for you the best ones.
note: 'You are lost' = long time no see

speaker: vendor_f
text: Avocado, avocado! Two for one thousand!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Cold juice! Passion, mango, cold cold!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Sugarcane! Sweet sugarcane, buy for the children!

speaker: mc_m
text: Goal! Goal! Ah, banange, what a goal!

speaker: mc_m
text: Come inside, the match has started! Only one thousand!

speaker: mc_m
text: The VJ is translating today! Come and watch the action film!

speaker: mc_m
text: Bring for me another cold one, please!

speaker: police_m
text: Stop there! Park aside, my friend.

speaker: police_m
text: Where is your helmet? And your permit?

speaker: police_m
text: You are carrying three people? Eh! Come here.

speaker: police_m
text: Okay, go. Next time, put on your helmet.

speaker: customer_f
text: Boda! Boda! Are you free?

speaker: customer_f
text: How much to Ntinda? Eh, that's too much, reduce!

speaker: customer_f
text: Driver, stage! Leave me here.

speaker: customer_f
text: Webale nnyo. Safe journey!

speaker: customer_f
text: Please drive slowly, I'm carrying eggs!

speaker: customer_m
text: Oli otya, boss? Take me to Wandegeya.

speaker: customer_m
text: I'm coming. Let me first pick my bag.

speaker: customer_m
text: Well done, my friend. You are fast!

speaker: customer_m
text: Oli otya?

speaker: customer_f
text: Bulungi, nawe?

speaker: customer_f
text: Gyebale ko!

speaker: customer_m
text: Kale, webale!

speaker: pastor_m
text: Praise the Lord! Can somebody say amen!

speaker: pastor_m
text: Welcome, welcome! Sit down, the service is starting.

speaker: vendor_f
text: Mobile money! Deposit, withdraw, airtime!

speaker: vendor_f
text: Airtime! Load your phone, sebo!
